content.text: Confirmed: `handleClick` only resets `busy` in the `.then()` success path; a rejected promise (failed export) leaves `busy` stuck `true`, matching the bug exactly.

input.title: Re-enable the export button after a failed export
input.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

handleClick only calls setBusy(false) in the success branch of exportReport(...).then(...). When the promise rejects (a failed export), busy stays true forever and the button remains disabled until a full page reload. Add a .catch (or try/finally with async/await) that resets busy to false and surfaces an error toast on failure.

File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

label: bug
file: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

In handleClick, setBusy(false) is only called inside the .then() success callback of exportReport(...). When the fetch rejects (a failed export), that callback never runs, so busy stays true and the button remains disabled until the page is reloaded. Adding a .catch/finally that resets busy on failure (and shows an error toast) fixes it.
